hard_fail_MDD.WARNING: ONLY 2.77%p margin to hard fail boundary. Any rebalancing noise or market shock could breach -45%.

regime_signal_integrity.note: Regime Engine v7.1 confirmed PIT-compliant (L-442). MRS uses expanding percentile threshold + slow-crisis defense.

pit_3_questions.q1_data_available: YES - MRS signal from regime_engine_daily.R uses t-1 lagged data. Threshold 20 is a design constant.
pit_3_questions.q2_future_influence: NO - MRS threshold 20 selected from regime distribution analysis, not performance optimization.
pit_3_questions.q3_result_bias: NO - VD+ overlay is a standard risk management technique (Moreira & Muir 2017). Not data-mined.

DSR.note: DSR < 0.95 similar to M05. Extreme kurtosis (290) from VD+ 50% exposure days (25.9% of sample). IC t-stat 12.05 provides robust alpha confirmation. DSR failure is flagged but not disqualifying for diversifier role.

score.note: MDD component very low (1.2/20) because MDD -42.2% is close to 45% cutoff.

crisis_corr_not_rising.CRITICAL: Crisis correlation 0.705 >> normal correlation 0.386. Diversification benefit COLLAPSES exactly when needed most. COVID corr 0.763 = near-perfect co-movement during crash.

gate_5_role_honesty_audit.role_honesty_finding: ROLE HONESTY VIOLATION: M06 claims diversifier role but exhibits CRISIS CORRELATION SURGE. Normal period corr 0.386 (acceptable) explodes to 0.705 during GFC+COVID. This is the opposite of diversifier behavior. The VD+ overlay (MRS>=20 -> 50% exposure) reduces exposure for BOTH anchor and M06 simultaneously via the same regime engine signal, creating synchronized risk-off behavior. During crisis, the remaining 50% exposure is highly correlated with anchor because both strategies hold quality/earnings stocks that co-move in stress.
mechanism_diagnosis: VD+ uses the SAME MRS signal as anchor (STR_1631 VD+). When MRS triggers, BOTH strategies de-risk simultaneously.
L-115 echo: Regime overlay creates behavioral similarity, not decorrelation.
Residual 50% exposure during MRS>=20 is concentrated in common quality factors, driving crisis corr to 0.76.
S5 Risk Assessment warned: 'VD+ overlay가 anchor와 동일 Regime Engine 사용 -> 양쪽 동시 현금화 위험'.

blend_70_30.WARNING: 70/30 blend MDD -47.9% BREACHES hard fail threshold (-45%). M06 at 30% allocation is NOT viable.

gate_5_role_honesty_audit.conclusion: M06 is NOT a genuine diversifier. It behaves as a quasi-correlated strategy that superficially decorrelates in normal times but re-correlates violently during crises. This is the worst possible diversifier profile - it promises protection but fails to deliver when most needed.

evt_gpd_shape.note: Positive xi from VD+ bimodal distribution (full/half exposure)

cvar_profile.assessment: CVaR99 at -5.2% daily is elevated relative to M05 (-4.7%).

GFC_2008.note: VD+ reduced to 50% exposure but still suffered -26.8% drawdown. DD Brake (M05) achieved 0% loss in same period.

COVID_2020.note: 50% exposure during COVID crash. Moderate but significant loss.

Rate_Hike_2022.note: MRS elevated throughout 2022. Sustained 50% exposure reduced absolute loss but also halved recovery potential.

gate_6_tail_risk.critical_finding: M06 MDD -42.23% has only 2.77%p margin to -45% hard fail. Given crisis correlation surge to 0.705, blend-level MDD -47.9% already breaches hard fail. Tail risk is UNACCEPTABLE for diversifier deployment.

mdd_margin_analysis.risk: EXTREME - any adverse revision to HRP weights, regime signal timing, or market microstructure could breach. 2.77%p is insufficient safety margin for production deployment.

high_risk_exposure_ratio.note: M06 spends 25.9% of all trading days at 50% exposure. This is very high and suggests MRS>=20 threshold is too sensitive, reducing effective alpha accumulation.

overall_verdict.downgrade_reason: Gate 5 Role Honesty Audit FAIL (crisis corr 0.705) + Gate 6 Tail Risk FAIL (MDD margin 2.77%p, blend MDD -47.9% breaches hard fail)
strengths: Highest standalone SR (1.232) and CAGR (31.0%) among all mutations
VD+ provides sustained risk reduction (25.9% time at 50% exposure)
Full-period corr 0.408 is within diversifier range
weaknesses: CRITICAL: Crisis correlation 0.705 (COVID 0.763) - diversifier role violation
MDD -42.23% with only 2.77%p margin to hard fail
Same MRS signal as anchor creates synchronized de-risking
25.9% time at reduced exposure limits alpha accumulation
recommendations: S7: RECOMMEND ARCHIVE. M06 is NOT viable as diversifier due to crisis correlation surge.
Alternative: M06 could be considered as a STANDALONE strategy (not diversifier) but MDD -42.23% near hard fail makes this risky.
If M06 is reconsidered, regime signal must differ from anchor (different MRS threshold or different signal entirely) to avoid synchronized de-risking.
M05 (DD Brake) is the superior diversifier candidate from this S5 round.

l_code.lesson_text: STR_1656_MLRA M06(HRP+VD+ MRS20)은 standalone SR 1.232로 최고 성과이지만, 위기 시 앵커 상관 0.705 급등으로 diversifier 역할 실패이다. 핵심 교훈: (1) 동일 regime signal(MRS)을 앵커와 diversifier가 공유하면 위기 시 동시 de-risk → 잔여 exposure의 상관이 급등한다. COVID 상관 0.763은 사실상 동일 전략 행동. (2) VD+ 50% exposure 축소는 MDD를 -67%에서 -42%로 완화했지만, hard fail 경계(-45%)에 2.77%p 여유밖에 없어 프로덕션 부적합. (3) 70/30 블렌드 MDD -47.9%는 hard fail 위반. 배분비 15% 이하에서도 위기 상관 급등으로 portfolio MDD 개선 제한적. 결론: diversifier의 regime overlay는 앵커와 독립적인 신호를 사용해야 하며, 동일 MRS 공유는 구조적으로 위기 상관을 높인다(L-115 재확인). DD Brake(M05)는 현금화 기반으로 이 문제를 회피.
